prompt: Which order keeps the whole picture on paper and uses paper large enough for Leon’s mount?
promptZh: 哪一組合能把整張照片印在相紙上，且相紙夠大、適用里昂的卡紙？

options.whyZh: 相紙等於卡紙開口，而且滿版會裁掉照片一部分。
相紙大於實測開口，完整置入保留橋的兩端。
相紙尺寸符合，但比例不同仍會裁圖。
照片畫面完整，但無法讓相紙邊緣壓在卡紙後。

explanationZh: 相紙大於實測開口，完整置入保留橋的兩端。
evidence: Choose Fit instead if you need to keep the whole picture. / Part of the paper needs to sit behind the mount, so the paper must be larger than the opening. / Please keep both ends of the bridge visible. / I measured Leon’s mount: its opening is 18 by 24 centimetres. / We offer 18 by 24 and 20 by 25 centimetre paper.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Choose Fit instead if you need to keep the whole picture.
Part of the paper needs to sit behind the mount, so the paper must be larger than the opening.
Please keep both ends of the bridge visible.
I measured Leon’s mount: its opening is 18 by 24 centimetres.
We offer 18 by 24 and 20 by 25 centimetre paper.

vocabulary.note: 此處須以實測尺寸為準，不是顧客先前猜測的尺寸。
